thread:
Alex K: FYI escalating AcroHealth onboarding activation drop — ~60% fewer activations after the SSO step since 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC. Support ticket #12345 opened, sending to CS for urgent handoff.
Miguel R: Reproduced locally, seeing idp token_exchange failures. Pinned log snippet to ticket:
```
2026-03-20T18:05:12Z ERROR idp token_exchange 403 invalid_grant user_id=***
```
Priya S: Thanks. Can CS own customer comms? They’re on annual renewal in 8 weeks — this looks like a renewal risk if not fixed fast.
Jordan L: On it. Priya can you do initial outreach? I’ll coordinate with eng. Proposed comms plan: ack immediately, give ETA ~2h, offer workaround, update every 2 hours. @Alex K share ticket link + SLA windows.
Alex K: Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/t/12345 (SOC-INC). Infra prelim ETA ~90m. Workaround we can offer: re-auth via incognito or rotate client secret temporarily.
Priya S: Sending ack now: "Thanks — investigating. For immediate access try incognito or re-linking SSO. We'll update in ~2h." Will also flag renewal risk to AE.
Jordan L: Confirmed. Ownership: Priya = comms owner; Jordan = escalation owner; Miguel = logs/engineer liaison. Add activation funnel monitor.
Miguel R: Added full log dump to ticket and pinged #eng-runtime. @infra-oncall please advise.
Oncall Bot: @eng-runtime oncall paged: INC-7789 — investigating IdP 403 responses.
Priya S: Ack sent at 18:14 UTC. Customer responded: "confirmed can't complete sign-up, revenue team blocked" — marked urgent.
Jordan L: If unresolved in 3 hours escalate to VP-CS and AE. Comms checklist: 1) Acknowledge 2) Offer workaround 3) ETA updates every 2h 4) Postmortem + credit if SLA missed. Priya, log this in account timeline.
Alex K: Noted renewal risk = HIGH, updating CRM.
Priya S: I'll schedule a 30-min sync at 19:00 UTC if we have progress, else 19:30. Exec contact ready if needed.
Jordan L: Next steps & deadlines: Miguel confirm root cause within 60m (by 19:14 UTC). Infra to provide hotfix timeline by 19:30. Priya to send customer update by 19:15. I'll prep exec note if >3h.
Miguel R: Root cause looks like IdP cert rotation causing token mismatch. Patch ready, running quick tests now.
Priya S: Customer asks for a written ETA for their execs — I sent a 19:30 hotfix ETA and copied Jordan.
Jordan L: Good. After patch, run activation funnel sanity and confirm numbers. Postmortem owner = Jordan. Proposed compensation: CS to propose credit up to 30 days usage if SLA hit.
Alex K: Ticket update: patch deployed 19:28 UTC, activations recovering, back to baseline by 19:45 UTC. Customer accepted apology; AE looped in for renewal follow-up. Closing escalation.
Priya S: Closing notes: schedule follow-up call next week, capture feedback on onboarding flow and SSO edge cases, create a short eval to catch this in future QA.
Jordan L: Thanks everyone — neat handoff. Will draft postmortem and share with CS/Support/Eng for distribution."
